raw_sections.summary:
SUMMARY
Finance professional with 4 years of experience in capital markets operations, private equity, fund accounting, and reconciliation. Skilled in account reconciliation, cash settlements, and handling capital calls, distributions, and capital account statements. Proficient in SWIFT messaging and ensuring data accuracy to support business decisions. Successfully collaborated with tech teams to streamline accounting processes. Strong client-facing abilities with a focus on operational efficiency and service quality.

Coforge Limited - Pune, India May 2026 - Present Team Lead

Fund Accounting Supporting fund accounting operations and ensuring timely completion of assigned deliverables.
Coordinating with internal stakeholders to address operational queries and process requirements. • Assisting in monitoring fund accounting activities while maintaining service quality standards. • Collaborating with team members to ensure accuracy and efficiency in day-to-day operations
BNY - Pune, India April 2024 - May 2026 Client- US Bank Associate
Reconciliation of the Alternatives investments funds processing capital call notices, distribution notices and capital account statements.
Calculated monthly NAVs for private equity and alternative investment funds, ensuring accuracy of portfolio valuation, income accruals, and expense allocations.
Analyzed Private equity funds structures, accounting flows and cash proceeds while addressing the

accounting discrepancies. Evaluated notice & ILPA templates to ensure accurate breakout of the cashflow transaction postings in the accounting system.
Coordinated with account managers and relationship managers to ensure positive client outcomes. • Reduced financial discrepancies by diligently reviewing account statements and identifying errors.
Managed high volumes of transactions while maintaining strict deadlines for reconciliation of the accounts and deliverables.
eClerx Services Limited - Pune, India December 2021 - March 2024 Client- Morgan Stanley Senior Financial Analyst
Drove financial efficiency by effectively processing incoming funds in Suspense through Nostro account

reconciliation and expeditious settlement, resulting in streamlined operations Executed seamless internal transfer of funds across accounts and facilitated the kickback of funds utilizing MT SWIFT messages, specifically MT199, MT299, MT103, MT900 & MT910 and MT202, ensuring smooth transactions
Managed end-to-end trade settlement and post-trade processing activities, ensuring timely and accurate settlement of transactions within defined market and client timelines. Performed trade reconciliation between internal accounting/operational records and external counterparty, broker, or custodian records, investigating and resolving trade discrepancies. Investigated unmatched trades, settlement exceptions, failed transactions, and reconciliation breaks, coordinating with relevant internal teams, counterparties, and agent banks for timely resolution. Performed cash and trade reconciliation and monitored outstanding items to ensure accurate accounting and settlement records. Supported the end-to-end trade lifecycle, including trade processing, validation, confirmation/matching, settlement,

•

Control team, fostering a collaborative environment Showcased proactive communication abilities by promptly initiating contact with agent banks via email correspondence and phone calls, effectively addressing and resolving delays in release of payments Proactively liaised with relevant Business Units, leveraging strong communication skills to facilitate the clearance of funds and uphold a consistent volume in the profile, resulting in efficient operations.
Minimized 30% ZBA breaks and speeding up same day settlement by utilizing Auto matching engine for the funds received on correct account.
PROJECTSEXECUTED



Successfully implemented the SSI updation project to target the reduction of internal transfers of funds from one account to another account. Minimized 30% ZBA breaks and expediting the process of same day settlement by utilizing Auto matching engine for the funds received on correct account. Spearheaded the process improvement idea to fix the challenges around SPSE of ledger missions by performing a client reach out to net off the missions instead of setting them up in gross and enabled auto matching of funds and ledgers in opposite direction in the risk application. Reduced 50% of total transfers executed by reconciliation team and generated a saving of processing time by 15% on the back of this project.
